title: Minimum cut is at most every vertex degree
statement: Let $G$ be a loopless multigraph, let $C$ be a minimum cut of $G$, and let $v$ be any vertex of $G$. Then the size of $C$ is at most the degree of $v$, that is, $\mathrm{size}(C) \le \deg(v)$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a minimum cut of G
v is a vertex of G
replaced:
If $C$ is a minimum cut of $G$ and $v \in V(G)$, then $\abs{C} \le \deg(v)$: otherwise
the singleton cut at $v$ would be smaller.
